         <hi rendition="#Style1">dang po la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> na re mtshan nyid du bkod pa gang zhig mtshon bya'i don ldog rkyang par ma grub pa yin no || de la rkyang par ma grub pas don ldog gzhan gyur dang mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa dang skyon med rnams bcad nas rang ldog rdzas med du mtshon no zhes zer ba ni ma yin no || rta la ba lang gis ba lang du mtshon na mtshan gzhi la srid par 'gyur te | <lb edRef="inst:5508" n="15b1"/> don ldog rkyang par ma grub pa'i phyir ro || rtags ma grub na don ldog du grub par thal la khyab pa khas blangs 'dod pa la tshad mas bsal pa'o || </hi></seg></TEI>
